ev.q: is a turn-based strategy 4X game developed by Amplitude Studios
each with their own asymmetrical gameplay, storyline, homeworlds, spaceships, heroes and technologies
set in a universe that was long ago dominated by a powerful race called the Endless
the galaxy is yet again thriving with life capable of interstellar travel
Each tree has five levels, which are only unlockable by researching different subjects in the level before
